node.statement: Fix arbitrary W, algebra, delta, and family g satisfying all hypotheses of node 1. Then the hypotheses put these data within the scope of lem-stage1-maurer-cartan-trivialization, and its tangent, bundle-trivialization, and equivariance conclusions transfer to this uniquely characterized family g, with preliminary distortion bound 1 + Cbar*epsilon_r.
